description: Feuerwehr Dienststellen Burgenland is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.bgld.gv.at. List of all departments of the Landesfeuerwehrverband Burgenland. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Fire brigade services Burgenland" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Feuerwehren, Dienststellen, Burgenland. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
